main_topic.main_title: 10 Best Bangkok Night Markets for Thai Street Food Lovers
main_topic.author: Feastography

primary_content.text: All over Thailand, you'll find the best food within night markets
Bangkok is a city known for many things, and Night Markets are one of them. Night Markets in Bangkok are legendary especially for foodies and Thai street food lovers like you and I.

I’ve explored and ate through plenty of Bangkok night markets and I wanted to share with you 10 of my personal favorites. From modern, trendy, and chic markets offering innovative twists on traditional Thai street food dishes, to historical roads brimming with Chinese influences and heritage.
Note that Bangkok has way more than 10, I just picked these ones based on my opinion that these are the best for new or seasoned travelers to Bangkok.

main_topic.main_title: 10 Best Bangkok Night Markets for Thai Street Food Lovers
main_topic.author: Feastography

primary_content.text: The Ratcahada Train Night Market, one of the most iconic night markets in Bangkok

In Thailand, street food and night markets go hand in hand. You can expect to find typical dishes like grilled pork skewers or the classic Pad Krapow but more often than not, especially in Bangkok, the night markets here are an outlet for vendors to create new deliciousness.

A lot of these markets also have spaces where you can sit down and enjoy your food, plus some of them even have stalls selling alcohol and cocktails if you want to relax the night away. If you’re looking for classier way to spend your night with alcohol then check out my recommendations for the best rooftop bars in Bangkok ( Pastel is on of my favorites).
Weekend Night Markets are even a bigger affair, popular markets like Chatuchak will often host larger numbers of stalls and vendors during the weekends.

Many temples throughout Thailand also have Temple fairs such as the Phra Pathom Chedi Annual Festival, and the Wat Saket Songkran Festival which celebrates both the traditions of the temples as well as hosting big open air markets and often carnival rides and games for locals to entertain and enjoy themselves,
